decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved plans and the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995, the existing front wall shall be permanently retained and the existing vehicle access shall not be enlarged or altered.

Condition : 6 - The habitable room hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the single-family dwelling known as 78 Harewood Road, Isleworth. The building shall not be used for any commercial use or as a separate residential unit.
Condition : 7 - The two roof lights to be installed within the front and rear roof planes of the dwelling house shall not project beyond the existing roof planes.
description: Conversion of existing garage to a habitable room and installation of rooflights to front and rear elevations of existing house.
